high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "dualipa." The post was made 7 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The post features a photo of a woman performing on stage with two other individuals. The woman in the center is holding a microphone and appears to be singing or speaking into it. She is wearing a black crop top and black pants, and her hair is styled in a high ponytail. The two individuals flanking her are dressed in white tops; one has short hair, and the other has curly hair.
